I have been a massage therapist for 31 years. Over the years I have learned many easy, at home massage techniques and would like to share them with you. In addition to these helpful techniques, I would love to share other beneficial tips for healthy living and just fun life “stuff”. Check out my TikTok channel, “massage shorties by Melody”. Mostly the same videos :) . Thanks for watching!



*The guidance and instructions provided do not replace that of a medical professional. Should you feel the need to seek out help for any ailments or problems you may be having please see a medical professional. If you have an emergency please dial 911 immediately.
